The '''2023–24 [[FC Barcelona|Futbol Club Barcelona]] season''' was the club's [[List of FC Barcelona seasons|125th season in existence]] and their [[La Liga records and statistics#All-time table|93rd consecutive season]] in the top flight. In addition to the [[2023–24 La Liga|domestic league]], Barcelona participated in this season's editions of the [[2023–24 Copa del Rey|Copa del Rey]], the [[2023–24 Supercopa de España|Supercopa de España]] and the [[2023–24 UEFA Champions League|UEFA Champions League]] (entering for the [[FC Barcelona in international football#European Cup / Champions League|20th consecutive season]]). The season covered the period from 1 July 2023 until 30 June 2024.

Barcelona played their official home matches for the entire season at the [[Estadi Olímpic Lluís Companys]] due to the start of ''Espai Barça'' project to revamp the club's sporting facilities.<ref>{{Cite news |date=19 April 2023 |title=FC Barcelona completes first phase of adaptation of Lluís Companys Olympic Stadium |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/club/news/3192245/fc-barcelona-completes-first-phase-of-adaptation-of-lluis-companys-olympic-stadium |access-date=12 May 2023 |publisher=[[FC Barcelona]] |archive-date=14 January 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250114131422/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/club/news/3192245/fc-barcelona-completes-first-phase-of-adaptation-of-lluis-companys-olympic-stadium |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/noticies/3745829/el-projecte-de-lspotify-camp-nou-avanca-segons-els-terminis-previstos/amp |title=Spotify Camp Nou project going to plan |publisher=FC Barcelona |date=21 October 2023 |access-date=21 February 2024 |archive-date=11 January 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260111050848/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/noticies/3745829/el-projecte-de-lspotify-camp-nou-avanca-segons-els-terminis-previstos/amp |url-status=live}}</ref>

This season was the first without captain [[Sergio Busquets]], who left the club as a free agent after 18 years, including 15 as a first-team player since the [[2007–08 FC Barcelona season|2007–08 season]]. It was also the first full season in 15 years without [[Gerard Piqué]], who retired in November 2022,<ref name="Sergio">{{cite news |title=Sergio Busquets to leave FC Barcelona at the end of the season |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3334561/sergio-busquets-to-leave-fc-barcelona-at-the-end-of-the-season |date=10 May 2023 |publisher=FC Barcelona |archive-date=9 February 2024 |access-date=12 May 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240209182649/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3334561/sergio-busquets-to-leave-fc-barcelona-at-the-end-of-the-season |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |last=Morse |first=Ben |date=4 November 2022 |title=Barcelona defender Gerard Piqué announces retirement at age 35 |url=https://www.cnn.com/2022/11/04/football/gerard-pique-retirement-barcelona-spain-spt-intl/index.html |access-date=10 January 2023 |publisher=[[CNN]] |archive-date=7 October 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241007091729/https://www.cnn.com/2022/11/04/football/gerard-pique-retirement-barcelona-spain-spt-intl/index.html |url-status=live}}</ref> and the first since [[2011–12 FC Barcelona season|2011–12]] without the left-back [[Jordi Alba]], who terminated his contract one year early by mutual agreement.<ref name="Alba">{{Cite news |date=24 May 2023 |title=Jordi Alba to leave FC Barcelona at the end of the season |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3486018/jordi-alba-to-leave-fc-barcelona-at-the-end-of-the-season |access-date=24 May 2023 |publisher=[[FC Barcelona]] |archive-date=31 May 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230531132839/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3486018/jordi-alba-to-leave-fc-barcelona-at-the-end-of-the-season |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |date=24 May 2023 |title=Jordi Alba se va del Barça |trans-title=Jordi Alba is leaving Barça |url=https://www.lavanguardia.com/deportes/fc-barcelona/20230524/8990778/jordi-alba-marcha-barca.html |access-date=24 May 2023 |publisher=[[La Vanguardia]] |language=es |archive-date=8 August 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250808044635/https://www.lavanguardia.com/deportes/fc-barcelona/20230524/8990778/jordi-alba-marcha-barca.html |url-status=live}}</ref>

Under head coach [[Xavi (footballer, born 1980)|Xavi]], Barcelona experienced an inconsistent season. In La Liga, they finished second behind [[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid]], failing to defend their [[2022–23 La Liga|previous season’s title]].<ref name=":20" /> They also finished as runners-up in the Supercopa de España, losing to Real Madrid in the final,<ref name=":18" /> and were eliminated by [[Athletic Bilbao]] in the quarter-finals of the Copa del Rey.<ref name=":19" /> In the UEFA Champions League, Barcelona finished first in [[2023–24 UEFA Champions League group stage#Group H|their group]] and reached the knockout stage for the first time in three seasons.<ref name=":13" /><ref name=":14" /> They defeated [[SSC Napoli|Napoli]] in the round of 16<ref name=":15" /> before being eliminated by [[Paris Saint-Germain F.C.|Paris Saint-Germain]] in the quarter-finals.<ref name=":16" /><ref name=":17" />

Despite finishing the campaign without a trophy, they secured qualification for the following season’s [[2025 Supercopa de España|Supercopa de España]].<ref name=":20" /> The season was Xavi’s last as head coach,<ref name=":21" /> with [[Hansi Flick]] appointed as his successor.<ref name=":22" />

== Season overview ==

=== Pre-season ===
On 12 May, Barcelona announced they would be touring the [[United States]] to participate in the pre-season Soccer Champions Tour, with four friendly matches against [[Juventus FC|Juventus]] in [[San Francisco]] on 22 July, [[Arsenal F.C.|Arsenal]] in [[Los Angeles]] on 26 July, [[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid]] in [[Dallas]] on 29 July, and [[AC Milan|Milan]] in [[Las Vegas]] on 1 August.<ref name=":11">{{cite news|url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/noticias/3341108/el-barca-regresa-a-los-estados-unidos-para-la-gira-de-pretemporada/|title=FC Barcelona return to the United States for preseason tour|publisher=FC Barcelona|date=12 May 2023|access-date=19 May 2023|archive-date=23 January 2025|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250123170306/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/noticias/3341108/el-barca-regresa-a-los-estados-unidos-para-la-gira-de-pretemporada/|url-status=live}}</ref><ref name=":12">{{cite news|url=https://en.as.com/soccer/barcelona-2023-usa-pre-season-tour-where-is-barca-playing-this-summer-in-the-us-n/|title=Barcelona 2023 USA pre-season tour: Where is Barça playing this summer in the US?|publisher=AS|date=12 May 2023|access-date=19 May 2023|archive-date=18 October 2025|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251018191724/https://en.as.com/soccer/barcelona-2023-usa-pre-season-tour-where-is-barca-playing-this-summer-in-the-us-n/|url-status=live}}</ref>

On 24 May, [[Jordi Alba]] and the club reached a mutual agreement to terminate the final year of his contract, bringing his time at Barcelona to an end.<ref name=Alba/>

On 8 June, Barcelona announced that the pre-season would start with the players medical examinations on 10 July.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/futbol/primer-equip/noticies/3532634/el-primer-equip-tornara-als-entrenaments-el-10-de-juliol|title=First team training to recommence on July 10|publisher=FC Barcelona|date=8 June 2023|access-date=9 June 2023|archive-date=9 June 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230609031721/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/futbol/primer-equip/noticies/3532634/el-primer-equip-tornara-als-entrenaments-el-10-de-juliol|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://en.as.com/soccer/barcelona-to-begin-202324-pre-season-on-10-july-n/?outputType=amp|title=Barcelona to begin 2023/24 pre-season on 10 July|publisher=AS|date=18 May 2023|access-date=9 June 2023|archive-date=12 June 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230612043315/https://en.as.com/soccer/barcelona-to-begin-202324-pre-season-on-10-july-n/?outputType=amp|url-status=live}}</ref>

On 26 June, Barcelona announced the signing of [[İlkay Gündoğan]], on a two-year deal until 2025.<ref name="Gundogan"/> Four days later, the club announced that they had reached an agreement to sever ties with [[Samuel Umtiti]].<ref name="Samuel Umtiti"/>

On 5 July, the club announced the signing of [[Iñigo Martínez]], on a two-year deal until 2025.<ref name="Iñigo">{{Cite web |date=5 July 2023 |title=Iñigo Martínez to join FC Barcelona |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3570200/inigo-martinez-to-join-fc-barcelona |access-date=14 October 2023 |website=FC Barcelona |archive-date=5 July 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230705080450/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3570200/inigo-martinez-to-join-fc-barcelona |url-status=live}}</ref> A week later, the club announced that they had reached an agreement with [[Athletico Paranaense]] for the transfer of Brazilian striker [[Vitor Roque]], with the player scheduled to arrive in the summer of 2024,<ref name="Roque"/> and that they would face [[Tottenham Hotspur F.C.|Tottenham Hotspur]] on 8 August to compete for the [[Joan Gamper Trophy]] at the [[Estadi Olímpic Lluís Companys]].<ref>{{cite news|title=FC Barcelona to face Tottenham Hotspur in the Gamper game|url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/futbol/primer-equip/noticies/3586774/el-tottenham-hotspur-sera-el-rival-del-gamper|publisher=FC Barcelona|date=12 July 2023|archive-date=21 January 2025|access-date=13 July 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250121051458/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/futbol/primer-equip/noticies/3586774/el-tottenham-hotspur-sera-el-rival-del-gamper|url-status=live}}</ref>

On 18 July, [[Pablo Torre (footballer)|Pablo Torre]] was loaned to [[Girona CF|Girona]] for the rest of the season,<ref name="Torre"/> and the following day the club announced the signing of [[Oriol Romeu]], on a three-year contract until 2026.<ref name="Romeu"/>

On 22 July, the club announced that their match against Juventus on the same date would be cancelled due to a viral [[gastroenteritis]] outbreak among a significant part of the Barcelona squad.<ref name="cancelled"/>

On 26 July, Barcelona started their pre-season with 5–3 defeat to [[Arsenal F.C.|Arsenal]]. [[Robert Lewandowski]], [[Raphinha]] and [[Ferran Torres]] were on the scoresheet for the team.<ref name=":5">{{Cite web|date=27 July 2023|url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3604687/match-report-barca-fall-to-arsenal-in-preseason-debut|title=MATCH REPORT: Barça fall to Arsenal in preseason debut|website=FC Barcelona|access-date=14 October 2023|archive-date=17 November 2025|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251117125912/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3604687/match-report-barca-fall-to-arsenal-in-preseason-debut|url-status=live}}</ref> The next day, [[Álex Collado]] departed for [[Real Betis]] for an undisclosed fee.<ref name="Àlex Collado"/> Two days after that, Barcelona got their first win of the pre-season, after they defeated [[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid]] 3–0 in the [[List of El Clásico matches#Friendlies and other matches|El Clásico]] thanks to goals from [[Ousmane Dembélé]], [[Fermín López]] and Ferran Torres;<ref name=":6">{{Cite web|date=29 July 2023|url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3610144/fc-barcelona-3-0-real-madrid-delight-in-dallas|title=FC Barcelona 3-0 Real Madrid: Delight in Dallas|website=FC Barcelona|access-date=14 October 2023|archive-date=22 May 2025|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250522092048/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3610144/fc-barcelona-3-0-real-madrid-delight-in-dallas|url-status=live}}</ref><ref name=":7">{{Cite web |date=29 July 2023 |url=https://www.marca.com/en/football/2023/07/30/64c5a4a3268e3ee15e8b45c5.html |title=Barcelona takes a lively El Clasico against an unlucky Real Madrid |website=[[Marca (newspaper)|Marca]] |access-date=14 October 2023 |archive-date=24 June 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240624062540/https://www.marca.com/en/football/2023/07/30/64c5a4a3268e3ee15e8b45c5.html |url-status=live}}</ref> the same day, [[Nico González (footballer, born 2002)|Nico González]] was sold to [[FC Porto|Porto]] for €8.5 million.<ref name="Nico2"/>

=== August ===
On 1 August, Barcelona defeated [[AC Milan|Milan]] 0–1 thanks to a goal from [[Ansu Fati]],<ref name=":8">{{Cite web |date=2 August 2023 |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3613182/ac-milan-0-1-fc-barcelona-ansu-the-ace-in-the-pack |title=AC Milan 0-1 FC Barcelona: Ansu the ace in the pack |access-date=14 October 2023 |website=FC Barcelona |archive-date=16 June 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250616230501/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3613182/ac-milan-0-1-fc-barcelona-ansu-the-ace-in-the-pack |url-status=live}}</ref> with [[Julián Araujo]] loaned to [[UD Las Palmas|Las Palmas]] for the rest of the season the same day.<ref name="Araujo"/>

On 8 August, Barcelona concluded the pre-season with a 4–2 win against [[Tottenham Hotspur F.C.|Tottenham Hotspur]] to retain [[Joan Gamper Trophy]].<ref name=":9">{{Cite web |date=8 August 2023 |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3621839/fc-barcelona-4-2-tottenham-late-turnaround-wins-dramatic-gamper |title=FC Barcelona 4-2 Tottenham: Late turnaround wins dramatic Gamper |access-date=14 October 2023 |website=FC Barcelona |archive-date=14 August 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250814205505/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3621839/fc-barcelona-4-2-tottenham-late-turnaround-wins-dramatic-gamper |url-status=live}}</ref> The goals were scored by Robert Lewandowski, Ferran Torres, Ansu Fati and [[Abde Ezzalzouli]], while [[Frenkie de Jong]] was chosen as [[Player of the match]].<ref name=":10">{{Cite web |date=8 August 2023 |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3621895/frenkie-de-jong-estrella-mvp-of-joan-gamper-trophy |title=Frenkie de Jong, Estrella MVP of Joan Gamper Trophy |access-date=14 October 2023 |website=FC Barcelona |archive-date=25 April 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240425032620/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3621895/frenkie-de-jong-estrella-mvp-of-joan-gamper-trophy |url-status=live}}</ref> The next day, the club announced the departure of [[Franck Kessié]] to Saudi club [[Al-Ahli Saudi FC|Al-Ahli]] for €12.5 million. He played 43 matches for the club and scored three goals.<ref name="Kessié"/>

On 12 August, [[Ousmane Dembélé]] was sold to [[Paris Saint-Germain]] for €50.4 million,<ref name="Dembélé"/> and the following day, Barcelona were held to a goalless draw by [[Getafe CF]] at the [[Coliseum Alfonso Perez|Coliseum]]. In an extremely physical match, both teams were reduced to ten men when Raphinha and Jamie Mata were sent off in the 42nd and 57th minutes respectively. The match ended with late drama when Barcelona were denied a penalty for a foul on Ronald Araujo right at the end.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3633061/getafe-0-0-fc-barcelona-scoreless-start-at-the-coliseum|title=Getafe 0-0 FC Barcelona: Scoreless start at the Coliseum|publisher=FC Barcelona|date=14 August 2023|access-date=14 August 2023|archive-date=13 September 2025|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250913050325/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3633061/getafe-0-0-fc-barcelona-scoreless-start-at-the-coliseum|url-status=live}}</ref> İlkay Gündoğan made his debut for the club in this match.

On 20 August, Barcelona got their first win of the season, winning 2–0 against [[Cádiz CF|Cádiz]], with the goals coming from [[Pedri]] and Ferran Torres.<ref>{{Cite web |date=20 August 2023 |title=Barcelona 2-0 Cadiz - Pedri and Ferran Torres score late as Catalans edge past plucky opponents in scrappy home opener |url=https://www.eurosport.com/football/la-liga/2023-2024/barcelona-v-cadiz-follow-live_sto9747844/story.shtml |access-date=20 August 2023 |website=[[Eurosport]] |archive-date=23 January 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250123170644/https://www.eurosport.com/football/la-liga/2023-2024/barcelona-v-cadiz-follow-live_sto9747844/story.shtml |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=20 August 2023 |title=FC Barcelona Vs. Cadiz Result: Pedri Prevents Breaking Of Unwanted 53-Year Record |url=https://www.forbes.com/sites/tomsanderson/2023/08/20/fc-barcelona-vs-cadiz-result-pedri-prevents-breaking-of-unwanted-53-year-record/?sh=739bfee97602 |access-date=20 August 2023 |website=[[Forbes]]}}</ref> The next day, [[Sergiño Dest]] was loaned to [[PSV Eindhoven]] for the rest of the season.<ref name="Dest2"/>

On 27 August, Barcelona defeated [[Villarreal CF|Villarreal]] 3–4 in a seven-goal thriller. [[Gavi (footballer)|Gavi]], Frenkie de Jong and Ferran Torres scored a goal each, along with Robert Lewandowski who scored his first goal of the season and sealed the win in the 71st minute. Fermín López made his debut in the match.<ref>{{Cite web |date=27 August 2023 |title=Villarreal 3-4 Barcelona: Robert Lewandowski nets winner in seven-goal thriller |url=https://www.eurosport.com/football/la-liga/2023-2024/villarreal-v-barcelona-la-liga-live_sto9759874/story.shtml |access-date=27 August 2023 |website=[[Eurosport]] |archive-date=23 January 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250123171415/https://www.eurosport.com/football/la-liga/2023-2024/villarreal-v-barcelona-la-liga-live_sto9759874/story.shtml |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=27 August 2023 |title=Barcelona fight back to win seven-goal thriller at Villarreal |url=https://www.reuters.com/sports/soccer/barcelona-fight-back-win-seven-goal-thriller-villarreal-2023-08-27/ |access-date=27 August 2023 |website=[[Reuters]] |archive-date=28 August 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230828122914/https://www.reuters.com/sports/soccer/barcelona-fight-back-win-seven-goal-thriller-villarreal-2023-08-27/ |url-status=live}}</ref> Four days later, the draw for the [[2023–24 UEFA Champions League group stage]] was held at the [[Grimaldi Forum]] in [[Monaco]]. Barcelona was drawn into [[2023–24 UEFA Champions League group stage#Group H|Group H]], alongside its opponents [[FC Porto|Porto]], [[FC Shakhtar Donetsk|Shakhtar Donetsk]] and debutants [[Royal Antwerp F.C.|Royal Antwerp]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=31 August 2023 |title=FC Barcelona now know their Champions League group stage opponents |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3661196/fc-barcelona-now-know-their-champions-league-group-stage-opponents/featured |access-date=2 September 2023 |website=FC Barcelona |archive-date=23 January 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250123173858/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3661196/fc-barcelona-now-know-their-champions-league-group-stage-opponents/featured |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=31 August 2023 |title=UEFA Champions League group stage draw: Where was it, when was it, who was involved? |url=https://www.uefa.com/uefachampionsleague/news/0283-18953d320597-7c194cf78346-1000--uefa-champions-league-group-stage-draw-where-was-it-when-was/ |access-date=2 September 2023 |website=[[UEFA|UEFA.com]] |archive-date=22 May 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250522215328/https://www.uefa.com/uefachampionsleague/news/0283-18953d320597-7c194cf78346-1000--uefa-champions-league-group-stage-draw-where-was-it-when-was/ |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2 September 2023 |title=Champions League group stage: All the fixtures |url=https://www.uefa.com/uefachampionsleague/news/0285-18e1b226cae3-4bbfb31dc1f7-1000--champions-league-group-stage-all-the-fixtures/ |access-date=2 September 2023 |website=[[UEFA|UEFA.com]] |archive-date=18 February 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250218011505/https://www.uefa.com/uefachampionsleague/news/0285-18e1b226cae3-4bbfb31dc1f7-1000--champions-league-group-stage-all-the-fixtures/ |url-status=live}}</ref>

=== September ===
On 1 September, Barcelona confirmed the signings of forward [[João Félix]] and defender [[João Cancelo]] on loan until the end of the season.<ref name=":0" /><ref name=":1" /> On the same day the club also announced that they had sold Abde Ezzalzouli to [[Real Betis]] for €7,5 million,<ref name="Ezzalzouli"/> and confirmed that they had loaned out three players until the end of the season: [[Clément Lenglet]] to [[Aston Villa F.C.|Aston Villa]],<ref name=":2" /> Ansu Fati to [[Brighton & Hove Albion F.C.|Brighton]]<ref name=":3" /> and [[Eric García (footballer, born 2001)|Eric García]] to [[Girona FC|Girona]].<ref name=":4" />

On 3 September, the team got a hard-fought 1–2 away win against [[CA Osasuna|Osasuna]], with [[Jules Koundé]] and Robert Lewandowski scoring the goals. New signings João Félix, João Cancelo and Iñigo Martínez made their debuts during the match.<ref>{{Cite web |date=3 September 2023 |title=Osasuna 1-2 Barcelona: Late Robert Lewandowski penalty hands Barça away win in La Liga |url=https://www.eurosport.com/football/la-liga/2023-2024/osasuna-v-barcelona-la-liga-live_sto9774778/story.shtml |access-date=3 September 2023 |website=[[Eurosport]] |archive-date=23 January 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250123172722/https://www.eurosport.com/football/la-liga/2023-2024/osasuna-v-barcelona-la-liga-live_sto9774778/story.shtml |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=3 September 2023 |title=FC Barcelona vs. Osasuna Result: Lewandowski The Hero As Catalans Keep Heat On Real Madrid |url=https://www.forbes.com/sites/tomsanderson/2023/09/03/fc-barcelona-vs-osasuna-result-lewandowski-the-hero-as-catalans-keep-heat-on-real-madrid/?sh=40ca88412e68 |access-date=3 September 2023 |website=[[Forbes]] |archive-date=23 January 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250123171236/https://www.forbes.com/sites/tomsanderson/2023/09/03/fc-barcelona-vs-osasuna-result-lewandowski-the-hero-as-catalans-keep-heat-on-real-madrid/?sh=40ca88412e68 |url-status=live}}</ref> Gavi made his 100th appearance for Barcelona, thus becoming the youngest Barça player ever to become a centenarian, reaching the figure at the age of 19 years and 27 days.<ref>{{Cite web |date=3 September 2023 |title=Gavi makes 100th appearance for FC Barcelona |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/news/3647941/gavi-makes-100th-appearance-for-fc-barcelona |access-date=5 September 2023 |website=FC Barcelona |archive-date=3 December 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241203232248/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/news/3647941/gavi-makes-100th-appearance-for-fc-barcelona |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=3 September 2023 |title=Gavi becomes the youngest Barça player to reach 100 games for club |url=https://www.sport.es/en/news/barca/gavi-becomes-the-youngest-barca-player-to-reach-100-games-for-club-91666155 |access-date=5 September 2023 |website=[[Sport (Spanish newspaper)|Sport]] |archive-date=27 September 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230927134647/https://www.sport.es/en/news/barca/gavi-becomes-the-youngest-barca-player-to-reach-100-games-for-club-91666155 |url-status=live}}</ref>

On 5 September, the nominees for the [[Golden Boy (award)|Golden Boy]] award were announced. Three Barcelona players were nominated: Pedri, Gavi and [[Alejandro Balde]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=5 September 2023 |title=Three blaugranes in contention for Golden Boy Award |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3671431/three-blaugranes-in-contention-for-golden-boy-award |access-date=7 September 2023 |website=FC Barcelona |archive-date=13 January 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250113010437/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3671431/three-blaugranes-in-contention-for-golden-boy-award |url-status=live}}</ref>
On the next day, the nominees for the [[2023 Ballon d'Or]] were announced. Robert Lewandowski and İlkay Gündoğan were nominated for the [[Ballon d'Or]] award. Barcelona had the most players nominated for the [[Kopa Trophy]] than any other club, with Alejandro Balde and holders of the award Pedri and Gavi representing the club. While [[Marc-André ter Stegen]] was nominated for the [[Yashin Trophy]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=6 September 2023 |title=Eight blaugranes nominated for the Ballon d'Or |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3675491/eight-blaugranes-nominated-for-the-ballon-dor |access-date=7 September 2023 |website=FC Barcelona |archive-date=21 June 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250621174748/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3675491/eight-blaugranes-nominated-for-the-ballon-dor |url-status=live}}</ref>

On 16 September, Barcelona got a comfortable 5–0 win against [[Real Betis]]. Both João Félix and João Cancelo scored their first goals for the club, Robert Lewandowski and Raphinha both scored a goal each, and the other goal was scored by Ferran Torres, who converted a free-kick in the 62nd minute, scoring the club's first free-kick goal in over two years, since [[Lionel Messi]] scored a free-kick in a league win against Valencia back in [[2020–21 FC Barcelona season|May of 2021]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=16 September 2023 |title=FC Barcelona vs. Real Betis Result: 'Two Joaos' Steal Show As Champions Return To Top Of La Liga |url=https://www.forbes.com/sites/tomsanderson/2023/09/16/fc-barcelona-vs-real-betis-result-two-joaos-steal-show-as-champions-return-to-top-of-la-liga/?sh=16e2a4264c35 |access-date=16 September 2023 |website=[[Forbes]] |archive-date=23 January 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250123174400/https://www.forbes.com/sites/tomsanderson/2023/09/16/fc-barcelona-vs-real-betis-result-two-joaos-steal-show-as-champions-return-to-top-of-la-liga/?sh=16e2a4264c35 |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=16 September 2023 |title=Barcelona 5-0 Real Betis: Robert Lewandowski and Joao Felix on target as La Liga champions put Betis to the sword |url=https://www.eurosport.com/football/la-liga/2023-2024/barcelona-v-real-betis-la-liga-live_sto9796882/story.shtml |access-date=16 September 2023 |website=[[Eurosport]] |archive-date=27 February 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250227224149/https://www.eurosport.com/football/la-liga/2023-2024/barcelona-v-real-betis-la-liga-live_sto9796882/story.shtml |url-status=live}}</ref>

On 19 September, the team started their Champions League campaign with a dominant 5–0 against [[Royal Antwerp FC|Royal Antwerp]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=19 September 2023 |title=Joao Felix shines in Barcelona rout of Antwerp |url=https://www.marca.com/en/football/champions-league/cronica/2023/09/19/6509fa7946163fb5198b45af.html |access-date=19 September 2023 |website=[[Marca (newspaper)|Marca]] |archive-date=16 January 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250116131152/https://www.marca.com/en/football/champions-league/cronica/2023/09/19/6509fa7946163fb5198b45af.html |url-status=live}}</ref> João Félix scored twice, Robert Lewandowski and Gavi scored a goal each and the other goal was an own goal from Royal Antwerp's defender [[Jelle Bataille]]. Lewandowski became the third player in history behind Lionel Messi and Cristiano Ronaldo to [[UEFA club competition records and statistics#Top scorers in UEFA club competitions|reach 100 goals in UEFA club competitions]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=19 September 2023 |title=FC Barcelona 5-0 Royal Antwerp: Brilliant start |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3691389/fc-barcelona-5-0-royal-antwerp-brilliant-start |access-date=19 September 2023 |website=FC Barcelona |archive-date=2 October 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231002023026/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3691389/fc-barcelona-5-0-royal-antwerp-brilliant-start |url-status=live}}</ref>

On 23 September, Barcelona completed an epic comeback defeating [[RC Celta de Vigo|Celta Vigo]] 3–2, after they were trailing 0–2 until the 81st minute, when Robert Lewandowski scored his first goal of the match and just four minutes later he scored his second, João Cancelo scored the last goal of the match in the 89th minute to complete the dramatic comeback. It's the first time in club's history in the league that the team has been able to overcome a two-goal deficit after the 80th minute.<ref>{{Cite web |date=23 September 2023 |title=Incredible late turnaround from Barcelona overturns a two-goal deficit to beat Celta Vigo |url=https://www.marca.com/en/football/spanish-football/cronica/2023/09/23/650f2dd0ca47410f478b457b.html |access-date=23 September 2023 |website=[[Marca (newspaper)|Marca]] |archive-date=23 January 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250123170858/https://www.marca.com/en/football/spanish-football/cronica/2023/09/23/650f2dd0ca47410f478b457b.html |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=23 September 2023 |title=Barcelona produce stunning comeback to beat Celta Vigo |url=https://sportsbrief.com/football/49440-barcelona-produce-stunning-comeback-beat-celta-vigo/ |access-date=23 September 2023 |website=SportsBrief |archive-date=30 October 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231030212535/https://sportsbrief.com/football/49440-barcelona-produce-stunning-comeback-beat-celta-vigo/ |url-status=live}}</ref>

On 26 September, Barcelona were held to a 2–2 draw away at [[RCD Mallorca|Mallorca]]. Raphinha scored one goal and Fermín López scored his first goal for the club.<ref>{{Cite web |date=26 September 2023 |title=FC Barcelona vs RCD Mallorca Result: Catalans Stay Top Of La Liga After Four-Goal Thriller |url=https://www.forbes.com/sites/tomsanderson/2023/09/26/fc-barcelona-vs-rcd-mallorca-catalans-stay-top-of-la-liga-four-goal-thriller/?sh=430772b733b9 |access-date=26 September 2023 |website=[[Forbes]] |archive-date=23 January 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250123171239/https://www.forbes.com/sites/tomsanderson/2023/09/26/fc-barcelona-vs-rcd-mallorca-catalans-stay-top-of-la-liga-four-goal-thriller/?sh=430772b733b9 |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=26 September 2023 |title=Youngster Lopez rescues Barca draw at Mallorca |url=https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20230926-youngster-lopez-rescues-barca-draw-at-mallorca |access-date=26 September 2023 |website=[[France 24]] |archive-date=24 January 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250124034511/https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20230926-youngster-lopez-rescues-barca-draw-at-mallorca |url-status=live}}</ref> Three days later, Barcelona ended the month with a 1–0 win against [[Sevilla FC|Sevilla]] thanks to an own goal scored by Sevilla's defender [[Sergio Ramos]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=29 September 2023 |title=Sergio Ramos own goal gifts Barcelona win over Sevilla |url=https://www.espn.com/soccer/report/_/gameId/674089 |access-date=29 September 2023 |website=[[ESPN]] |archive-date=23 January 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250123170208/https://www.espn.com/soccer/report/_/gameId/674089 |url-status=live}}</ref>

=== October ===
On 4 October, Barcelona defeated [[FC Porto|Porto]] 0–1 away thanks to a Ferran Torres goal at the end of the first half.<ref>{{Cite web |date=4 October 2023 |title=Ferran Torres replaces the injured Lewandowski and fires Barcelona to victory in Porto |url=https://www.marca.com/en/football/champions-league/cronica/2023/10/04/651dc5ece2704e10ab8b4569.html |access-date=4 October 2023 |website=[[Marca (newspaper)|Marca]] |archive-date=23 January 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250123175907/https://www.marca.com/en/football/champions-league/cronica/2023/10/04/651dc5ece2704e10ab8b4569.html |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=4 October 2023 |title=Torres scrapes Barca important win at Porto |url=https://sportsbrief.com/football/50165-torres-scrapes-barca-important-win-porto/ |access-date=4 October 2023 |website=SportsBrief.com |archive-date=4 December 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231204151251/https://sportsbrief.com/football/50165-torres-scrapes-barca-important-win-porto/ |url-status=live}}</ref> This match was [[Xavi (footballer, born 1980)|Xavi]]'s 100th match in charge as a coach, during which time the team has amassed 63 wins and has scored 191 goals.<ref>{{Cite web |date=4 October 2023 |title=Xavi Hernández: 100 games as FC Barcelona manager |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3718052/xavi-hernandez-100-games-as-fc-barcelona-manager |access-date=4 October 2023 |website=FC Barcelona |archive-date=28 December 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241228100443/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3718052/xavi-hernandez-100-games-as-fc-barcelona-manager |url-status=live}}</ref> With his start in this match, Lamine Yamal became [[European Cup and UEFA Champions League records and statistics#Oldest and youngest 2|the youngest player ever to start a Champions League match]], just three days younger than [[Celestine Babayaro]] was in November 1994 when he started a game for [[RSC Anderlecht|Anderlecht]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=4 October 2023 |title=Lamine Yamal, youngest starter ever in the Champions League |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3721123/lamine-yamal-youngest-starter-ever-in-the-champions-league |access-date=4 October 2023 |website=FC Barcelona |archive-date=5 October 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231005015703/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3721123/lamine-yamal-youngest-starter-ever-in-the-champions-league |url-status=live}}</ref>

On 8 October, Barcelona were held to a 2–2 draw against [[Granada CF|Granada]] away.<ref>{{Cite web |date=8 October 2023 |title=Granada 2-2 Barcelona - Xavi's side rescue point in dramatic late equaliser in La Liga encounter |url=https://www.eurosport.com/football/la-liga/2023-2024/granada-v-barcelona-la-liga-live_sto9825918/story.shtml |access-date=8 October 2023 |website=[[Eurosport]] |archive-date=11 December 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231211002817/https://www.eurosport.com/football/la-liga/2023-2024/granada-v-barcelona-la-liga-live_sto9825918/story.shtml |url-status=live}}</ref> [[Sergi Roberto]] and Lamine Yamal scored a goal each, with the latter netting his first goal for the club and becoming the youngest La Liga goalscorer ever aged 16 years and 87 days, breaking the record held by [[Malaga CF|Malaga]]'s [[Fabrice Olinga]], who scored against Celta Vigo in 2012 aged 16 years and 98 days.<ref>{{Cite web |date=8 October 2023 |title=Barcelona's 16-year-old Yamal becomes LaLiga's youngest scorer |url=https://www.reuters.com/sports/soccer/barcelonas-16-year-old-yamal-becomes-laligas-youngest-scorer-2023-10-08/ |access-date=8 October 2023 |website=[[Reuters]] |archive-date=17 October 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231017095204/https://www.reuters.com/sports/soccer/barcelonas-16-year-old-yamal-becomes-laligas-youngest-scorer-2023-10-08/ |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=8 October 2023 |title=Lamine Yamal's record-breaking goal helps Barcelona rescue draw at Granada |url=https://www.marca.com/en/football/spanish-football/cronica/2023/10/08/65230ee9268e3ea73e8b459e.html |access-date=8 October 2023 |website=[[Marca (newspaper)|Marca]] |archive-date=23 January 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250123170831/https://www.marca.com/en/football/spanish-football/cronica/2023/10/08/65230ee9268e3ea73e8b459e.html |url-status=live}}</ref>

After the international break, Barcelona defeated [[Athletic Bilbao]] 1–0 on 22 October, thanks to a goal from teenage debutant [[Marc Guiu]] who scored his first goal for the club just 23 seconds after coming on as a substitute, and became the youngest Barcelona player to debut with a goal in La Liga in the 21st century at just 17 years and 291 days.<ref>{{Cite web |date=22 October 2023 |title=Barcelona teenager Guiu debuts with winner over Bilbao |url=https://www.espn.com/soccer/report/_/gameId/674101 |access-date=22 October 2023 |website=[[ESPN]] |archive-date=23 January 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250123171411/https://www.espn.com/soccer/report/_/gameId/674101 |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=22 October 2023 |title=Barcelona 1-0 Athletic Club - Teenager Marc Guiu goal snatches win for Barca |url=https://www.eurosport.com/football/la-liga/2023-2024/barcelona-v-athletic-club-la-liga-live-la-liga-live_sto9843700/story.shtml |access-date=22 October 2023 |website=[[Eurosport]] |archive-date=22 October 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231022210726/https://www.eurosport.com/football/la-liga/2023-2024/barcelona-v-athletic-club-la-liga-live-la-liga-live_sto9843700/story.shtml |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=22 October 2023 |title=Teen striker Guiu snatches Barca win over Athletic |url=https://uk.news.yahoo.com/teen-striker-guiu-snatches-barca-210513713.html |access-date=22 October 2023 |website=[[Yahoo!|Yahoo!News]] |archive-date=31 October 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231031042326/https://uk.news.yahoo.com/teen-striker-guiu-snatches-barca-210513713.html |url-status=live}}</ref>

On 25 October, the team beat [[FC Shakhtar Donetsk|Shakhtar Donetsk]] 2–1 thanks to goals from Ferran Torres and Fermín López.<ref>{{Cite web |date=25 October 2023 |title=Barcelona edge Shakhtar to stay perfect in Champions League |url=https://www.espn.com/soccer/report/_/gameId/687577 |access-date=25 October 2023 |website=[[ESPN]] |archive-date=30 July 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250730034630/https://www.espn.com/soccer/report/_/gameId/687577 |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=25 October 2023 |title=Barcelona 2-1 Shakhtar Donetsk: Fermin Lopez stars in Champions League win |url=https://www.sport.es/en/news/barca/barcelona-2-1-shakhtar-donetsk-fermin-lopez-stars-in-champions-league-win-93797588 |access-date=25 October 2023 |website=[[Sport (Spanish newspaper)|Sport]] |archive-date=30 October 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231030041719/https://www.sport.es/en/news/barca/barcelona-2-1-shakhtar-donetsk-fermin-lopez-stars-in-champions-league-win-93797588 |url-status=live}}</ref>

On 28 October, Barcelona suffered their first defeat of the season after they were defeated 1–2 by [[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid]] in the first [[El Clásico]] of the season. İlkay Gündoğan scored his first goal for the club.<ref>{{Cite web |date=28 October 2023 |title=FC Barcelona 1-2 Real Madrid: Late frustration |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3756428/fc-barcelona-1-2-real-madrid-late-frustration |access-date=28 October 2023 |website=FC Barcelona |archive-date=18 November 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251118050345/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3756428/fc-barcelona-1-2-real-madrid-late-frustration |url-status=live}}</ref>

=== November ===
On 4 November, Barcelona got a narrow 0–1 away win against [[Real Sociedad]] thanks to a last minute header from [[Ronald Araújo]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=4 November 2023 |title=Araujo's late goal gives Barcelona 1-0 win at Real Sociedad |url=https://www.reuters.com/sports/soccer/araujos-late-goal-gives-barcelona-1-0-win-real-sociedad-2023-11-04/ |access-date=4 November 2023 |website=[[Reuters]] |archive-date=8 November 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231108215935/https://www.reuters.com/sports/soccer/araujos-late-goal-gives-barcelona-1-0-win-real-sociedad-2023-11-04/ |url-status=live}}</ref>

On 7 November, Barcelona suffered a narrow 1–0 defeat against [[FC Shakhtar Donetsk|Shakhtar Donetsk]] under controversial circumstances after three penalties for the team were denied by ''[[Video assistant referee|Video Assistant Referee (VAR)]]'', of which two were handballs inside the box which were not called and the third was a foul on [[João Félix]] inside the penalty area which was also not given even after ''VAR'' checked the incident.<ref>{{Cite web |date=7 November 2023 |title=Sikan scores to give Shakhtar shock win against Barcelona |url=https://www.reuters.com/sports/soccer/sikan-scores-give-shakhtar-shock-win-against-barcelona-2023-11-07/ |access-date=7 November 2023 |website=[[Reuters]] |archive-date=9 December 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231209033254/https://www.reuters.com/sports/soccer/sikan-scores-give-shakhtar-shock-win-against-barcelona-2023-11-07/ |url-status=live}}</ref>

On 12 November, the team defeated [[Deportivo Alavés]] 2–1 thanks to a Robert Lewandowski brace in the second half.<ref>{{Cite web |date=12 November 2023 |title=Barcelona 2-1 Deportivo Alaves - Robert Lewandowski brace gives Barca comeback La Liga win over Deportivo Alaves |url=https://www.eurosport.com/football/la-liga/2023-2024/barcelona-v-deportivo-alaves-la-liga-live_sto9877559/story.shtml |access-date=12 November 2023 |website=[[Eurosport]] |archive-date=28 February 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250228065540/https://www.eurosport.com/football/la-liga/2023-2024/barcelona-v-deportivo-alaves-la-liga-live_sto9877559/story.shtml |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=12 November 2023 |title=Lewandowski rescues Barca and ends drought with Alaves double |url=https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20231112-lewandowski-rescues-barca-and-ends-drought-with-alaves-double |access-date=12 November 2023 |website=[[France24]] |archive-date=13 February 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240213204054/https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20231112-lewandowski-rescues-barca-and-ends-drought-with-alaves-double |url-status=live}}</ref>

On 25 November, Barcelona were held to a 1–1 draw against [[Rayo Vallecano]], with the only goal for the ''Blaugrana'' being an own goal by Rayo Vallecano's defender [[Florian Lejeune]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=25 November 2023 |title=Rayo Vallecano 1-1 FC Barcelona: Reaction comes too late |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3794252/rayo-vallecano-1-1-fc-barcelona-reaction-comes-too-late |access-date=25 November 2023 |website=FC Barcelona |archive-date=23 January 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250123173039/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3794252/rayo-vallecano-1-1-fc-barcelona-reaction-comes-too-late |url-status=live}}</ref>

Barcelona concluded the month with a decisive 2–1 win against [[FC Porto|Porto]] on 28 November.<ref>{{Cite web |date=28 November 2023 |title=FC Barcelona 2-1 Porto: Job done! |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3800285/fc-barcelona-2-1-porto-job-done |access-date=28 November 2023 |website=FC Barcelona |archive-date=23 January 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250123174821/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3800285/fc-barcelona-2-1-porto-job-done |url-status=live}}</ref><ref name=":13">{{Cite web |date=28 November 2023 |title=Barcelona beat Porto to secure Champions League last-16 spot |url=https://www.espn.com/soccer/report/_/gameId/687607 |access-date=28 November 2023 |website=[[ESPN]] |archive-date=17 May 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240517111532/https://www.espn.com/soccer/report/_/gameId/687607 |url-status=live}}</ref> The win secured Barcelona's advance to the [[2023–24 UEFA Champions League knockout phase|knockout stage]] for the first time in three years after they had failed to advance in the previous two seasons;<ref>{{Cite web |date=28 November 2023 |title=Cancelo and Felix fire Barca past Porto into Champions League last 16 |url=https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20231128-cancelo-and-felix-fire-barca-past-porto-into-champions-league-last-16 |access-date=28 November 2023 |website=[[France24]] |archive-date=23 January 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250123185026/https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20231128-cancelo-and-felix-fire-barca-past-porto-into-champions-league-last-16 |url-status=live}}</ref> the win also confirmed the team as the [[2023–24 UEFA Champions League group stage#Group H|group winners]]. João Cancelo and João Félix scored the goals for the team.<ref name=":14">{{Cite news |date=28 November 2023 |title=Barcelona beats Porto 2-1 to return to knockout stage of Champions League |url=https://www.washingtonpost.com/sports/soccer/2023/11/28/barcelona-porto-champions-league/0082ce0e-8e3b-11ee-95e1-edd75d825df0_story.html |access-date=28 November 2023 |newspaper=[[The Washington Post]]}}</ref>

=== December ===
On 3 December, Barcelona got a hard-fought 1–0 win over [[Atlético Madrid]], with João Félix scoring the only goal of the match.<ref>{{Cite web |date=3 December 2023 |title=Barcelona 1-0 Atletico Madrid - Barca edge out visitors courtesy of Joao Felix goal in La Liga clash |url=https://www.eurosport.com/football/la-liga/2023-2024/barcelona-v-atletico-madrid-la-liga-live_sto9903971/story.shtml |access-date=3 December 2023 |website=[[Eurosport]] |archive-date=3 December 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231203225308/https://www.eurosport.com/football/la-liga/2023-2024/barcelona-v-atletico-madrid-la-liga-live_sto9903971/story.shtml |url-status=live}}</ref>

On 10 December, Barcelona suffered their second league defeat of the season, losing 2–4 to [[Girona FC|Girona]], with Robert Lewandowski and İlkay Gündoğan scoring the only goals for the team.<ref>{{Cite web |date=10 December 2023 |title=Barcelona 2-4 Girona - Barca humbled by visitors in huge La Liga result as blow for title chances |url=https://www.eurosport.com/football/la-liga/2023-2024/la-liga-live_sto9912725/story.shtml |access-date=10 December 2023 |website=[[Eurosport]] |archive-date=12 December 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231212131856/https://www.eurosport.com/football/la-liga/2023-2024/la-liga-live_sto9912725/story.shtml |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=10 December 2023 |title=Girona double up Barcelona to restore LaLiga lead |url=https://www.espn.com/soccer/report/_/gameId/674163 |access-date=10 December 2023 |website=[[ESPN]] |archive-date=23 January 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250123190428/https://www.espn.com/soccer/report/_/gameId/674163 |url-status=live}}</ref>

Three days later, Barcelona suffered a 3–2 loss against [[Royal Antwerp F.C.|Antwerp]] in the last matchday of the group stage. Barcelona and Porto finished the group with 12 points each, however Barcelona finished first in the group because of their better head-to-head record against Porto. Ferran Torres and Marc Guiu got on the scoresheet for the team. [[Héctor Fort]] made his debut in the match.<ref>{{Cite web |date=13 December 2023 |title=Surprise win gives Antwerp first points of Champions League campaign |url=https://www.espn.com/soccer/report/_/gameId/687627 |access-date=13 December 2023 |website=[[ESPN]] |archive-date=23 January 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250123174534/https://www.espn.com/soccer/report/_/gameId/687627 |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=13 December 2023 |title=Barcelona fall to humbling defeat in Antwerp |url=https://www.marca.com/en/football/champions-league/cronica/2023/12/13/657a1fef22601df7118b45fc.html |access-date=13 December 2023 |website=[[Marca (newspaper)|MARCA]] |archive-date=27 October 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241027193517/https://www.marca.com/en/football/champions-league/cronica/2023/12/13/657a1fef22601df7118b45fc.html |url-status=live}}</ref>

On 16 December, Barcelona drew 1–1 against [[Valencia CF|Valencia]], with João Félix scoring the only goal for the Catalans.<ref>{{Cite web |date=16 December 2023 |title=Valenica 1-1 Barcelona: Joao Felix goal cancelled out by Hugo Guillamon as Barca drop more points in La Liga title race|url=https://www.eurosport.com/football/la-liga/2023-2024/valencia-v-barcelona-la-liga-live_sto9921493/story.shtml |access-date=16 December 2023 |website=[[Eurosport]]}}</ref>

Barcelona got a hard-fought 3–2 victory over [[UD Almería|Almería]] in their last competitive match of the year on 20 December, thanks to a brace from Sergi Roberto and a goal from Raphinha.<ref>{{Cite web |date=20 December 2023 |title=Wasteful Barcelona salvage 3-2 win against bottom side Almeria|url=https://www.reuters.com/sports/soccer/wasteful-barcelona-salvage-3-2-win-against-bottom-side-almeria-2023-12-20/ |access-date=20 December 2023 |website=[[Reuters]]}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=20 December 2023 |title=Barcelona scrape past lowly Almeria but Xavi still under pressure |url=https://www.marca.com/en/football/spanish-football/cronica/2023/12/20/6583449822601dac678b45ab.html |access-date=20 December 2023 |website=[[Marca (newspaper)|MARCA]] |archive-date=23 January 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250123175410/https://www.marca.com/en/football/spanish-football/cronica/2023/12/20/6583449822601dac678b45ab.html |url-status=live}}</ref>

Barcelona concluded the year with a 2–3 defeat in a friendly against Mexican side [[Club América]] on 21 December.<ref name="BarcelonaClubAmerica">{{cite news|url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3831663/barca-2-3-club-america-defeat-in-dallas|title=Barça 2-3 Club América: Defeat in Dallas|publisher=FC Barcelona|date=22 December 2023|access-date=22 December 2023|archive-date=11 February 2025|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250211083521/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3831663/barca-2-3-club-america-defeat-in-dallas|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=22 December 2023 |title=FC Barcelona Fall Short Against Club América |url=https://www.beinsports.com/en-us/soccer/la-liga/articles-video/fc-barcelona-fall-short-against-club-am%C3%A9rica-2023-12-22 |access-date=22 December 2023 |website=[[beIN Sports]] |archive-date=23 December 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231223022136/http://www.beinsports.com/en-us/soccer/la-liga/articles-video/fc-barcelona-fall-short-against-club-am%C3%A9rica-2023-12-22 |url-status=live}}</ref>

On 27 December, Barcelona officially confirmed the acceleration of Vitor Roque's arrival from Athletico Paranaense, announcing the striker's immediate integration into the first-team squad ahead of the winter transfer window.<ref>{{Cite news |date=27 December 2023 |title=Vitor Roque arrives in Barcelona |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/news/3838704/vitor-roque-arrives-in-barcelona |access-date=8 September 2026 |publisher=FC Barcelona |archive-date=8 September 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260908060631/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/news/3838704/vitor-roque-arrives-in-barcelona |url-status=live}}</ref>

=== January ===
On 4 January, Barcelona started the new year with a comeback win, defeating [[UD Las Palmas|Las Palmas]] 1–2 after going 1–0 down in the 12th minute. Ferran Torres scored the equaliser in the 55th minute, while İlkay Gündoğan scored the winning goal in the 93rd minute with a penalty kick.<ref>{{Cite web |date=4 January 2024 |title=Last-gasp Gündoğan penalty earns Barcelona win at Las Palmas |url=https://www.espn.com/soccer/report/_/gameId/674200 |access-date=4 January 2024 |website=[[ESPN]] |archive-date=23 January 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250123174926/https://www.espn.com/soccer/report/_/gameId/674200 |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=4 January 2024 |title=Las Palmas 1-2 Barcelona: Ilkay Gundogan's injury-time penalty sees Barca snatch comeback win to boost La Liga title bid |url=https://www.eurosport.com/football/la-liga/2023-2024/las-palmas-v-barcelona-la-liga-live_sto9940382/story.shtml |access-date=4 January 2024 |website=[[Eurosport]] |archive-date=4 January 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240104230945/https://www.eurosport.com/football/la-liga/2023-2024/las-palmas-v-barcelona-la-liga-live_sto9940382/story.shtml |url-status=live}}</ref> New signing [[Vitor Roque]] made his debut with the team.<ref>{{Cite web |date=4 January 2024 |title=Las Palmas 1-2 FC Barcelona: Epic comeback to start the year |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3849272/las-palmas-1-2-fc-barcelona-epic-comeback-to-start-the-year |access-date=4 January 2024 |website=FC Barcelona |archive-date=10 February 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250210172319/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3849272/las-palmas-1-2-fc-barcelona-epic-comeback-to-start-the-year |url-status=live}}</ref>

On 7 January, Barcelona defeated [[UD Barbastro|Barbastro]] 2–3 and advanced to the [[2023–24 Copa del Rey#Round of 16|Copa del Rey round of 16]] thanks to goals from López, Raphinha and Lewandowski.<ref>{{Cite web |date=7 January 2024 |title=Barça, to the round of 16 of the Cup with suffering against Barbastro (2-3) |url=https://www.fcbarcelonanoticias.com/en/copa-del-rey/the-barca-to-eighth-of-glass-with-suffering-in-front-of-the-barbastro-2-3_299687_102.html |access-date=7 January 2024 |website=FCBarcelonaNoticias.com |archive-date=10 November 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251110222217/https://www.fcbarcelonanoticias.com/en/copa-del-rey/the-barca-to-eighth-of-glass-with-suffering-in-front-of-the-barbastro-2-3_299687_102.html |url-status=live}}</ref>

On 11 January, Barcelona advanced to the [[2024 Supercopa de España final]] after they defeated [[CA Osasuna|Osasuna]] 2–0 in the semi-final thanks to goals from Lewandowski and Yamal.<ref>{{Cite web |date=11 January 2024 |title=FC Barcelona 2-0 Osasuna: Super finalists! |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3854155/fc-barcelona-2-0-osasuna-super-finalists |access-date=11 January 2024 |website=FC Barcelona |archive-date=16 June 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250616230329/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3854155/fc-barcelona-2-0-osasuna-super-finalists |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=11 January 2024 |title=Barcelona 2-0 Osasuna: Robert Lewandowski nets as Xavi's side through to face Real Madrid in Supercopa final |url=https://www.eurosport.com/football/spanish-supercopa/2023-2024/barcelona-v-osasuna-spanish-supercopa-live_sto9948831/story.shtml |access-date=11 January 2024 |website=[[Eurosport]] |archive-date=28 February 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250228062405/https://www.eurosport.com/football/spanish-supercopa/2023-2024/barcelona-v-osasuna-spanish-supercopa-live_sto9948831/story.shtml |url-status=live}}</ref> With his appearance and goal in the 93rd minute, Yamal became the youngest player to take part in the competition and the youngest scorer at the age of 16 years and 182 days, beating the previous record for the 21st century set by Ansu Fati at the age of 17 years and 70 days.<ref>{{Cite web |date=11 January 2024 |title=Lamine Yamal, youngest player and goalscorer ever in the Super Cup |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3853933/lamine-yamal-youngest-player-and-goalscorer-ever-in-the-super-cup |access-date=11 January 2024 |website=FC Barcelona |archive-date=14 January 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240114134404/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3853933/lamine-yamal-youngest-player-and-goalscorer-ever-in-the-super-cup |url-status=live}}</ref>

On 14 January, Barcelona suffered a 4–1 defeat against [[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid]] in the Supercopa final with Lewandowski scoring the only goal for the team.<ref>{{Cite web |date=14 January 2024 |title=Real Madrid 4-1 FC Barcelona: Super Cup defeat |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3857625/real-madrid-4-1-fc-barcelona-super-cup-defeat |access-date=14 January 2024 |website=FC Barcelona |archive-date=27 January 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240127053209/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3857625/real-madrid-4-1-fc-barcelona-super-cup-defeat |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=14 January 2024 |title=Vinícius Júnior leads Real Madrid to Super Cup triumph over Barcelona |url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/2024/jan/14/real-madrid-barcelona-spanish-super-cup-final |access-date=14 January 2024 |website=[[The Guardian]]}}</ref>

On 18 January, the team advanced to the [[2023–24 Copa del Rey#Quarter-finals|Copa del Rey quarter-finals]] after they defeated [[Unionistas de Salamanca CF|Unionistas]] 1–3, with the goals coming from Torres, Koundé and Balde.<ref>{{Cite web |date=18 January 2024 |title=Unionistas de Salamanca 1-3 FC Barcelona: One step closer |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3861192/unionistas-de-salamanca-1-3-fc-barcelona-one-step-closer |access-date=18 January 2024 |website=FC Barcelona |archive-date=28 December 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241228111005/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3861192/unionistas-de-salamanca-1-3-fc-barcelona-one-step-closer |url-status=live}}</ref> [[Pau Cubarsí]] made his debut in the match, which also saw Frenkie de Jong reach his 200th appearance for Barcelona.<ref>{{Cite web |date=18 January 2024 |title=Frenkie de Jong makes 200th appearance for FC Barcelona |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3861197/frenkie-de-jong-makes-200th-appearance-for-fc-barcelona |access-date=18 January 2024 |website=FC Barcelona |archive-date=14 May 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250514210643/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3861197/frenkie-de-jong-makes-200th-appearance-for-fc-barcelona |url-status=live}}</ref>

Barcelona returned to league action on 21 January, winning 2–4 against [[Real Betis]]. Ferran Torres marked his 100th appearance for the club with a [[hat-trick]], with the other goal coming from João Félix.<ref>{{Cite web |date=21 January 2024 |title=Real Betis 2-4 Barcelona: Ferran Torres hat-trick gives Xavi's side win in La Liga |url=https://www.eurosport.com/football/la-liga/2023-2024/real-betis-v-barcelona-la-liga-live_sto9975765/story.shtml |access-date=21 January 2024 |website=[[Eurosport]]}}</ref>

On 24 January, Barcelona were eliminated from the Copa del Rey after they suffered a 4–2 away defeat against [[Athletic Bilbao]] in the quarter-finals. Lewandowski and Yamal scored the only goals for the team.<ref>{{Cite web |date=25 January 2024 |title=Athletic Club 4-2 FC Barcelona: Knocked out in extra time |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3866820/athletic-club-4-2-fc-barcelona-beaten-in-extra-time |access-date=25 January 2024 |website=FC Barcelona |archive-date=23 January 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250123173328/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3866820/athletic-club-4-2-fc-barcelona-beaten-in-extra-time |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=25 January 2024 |title=Athletic Bilbao 4-2 Barcelona: Basque side win Copa del Rey thriller |url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/68088409 |access-date=25 January 2024 |website=[[BBC]] |archive-date=13 March 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240313125331/https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/68088409 |url-status=live}}</ref>

On 27 January, Barcelona suffered a dramatic 3–5 defeat against [[Villarreal CF|Villarreal]] in controversial circumstances after they had a penalty overturned by ''VAR''.<ref>{{Cite web |date=27 January 2024 |title=Five-goal Villarreal stun champions Barcelona |url=https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20240127-five-goal-villarreal-stun-champions-barcelona |access-date=27 January 2024 |website=[[France24]] |archive-date=13 February 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240213204053/https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20240127-five-goal-villarreal-stun-champions-barcelona |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=27 January 2024 |title=FC Barcelona Mounts Epic Three Goal Eleven-Minute Comeback And Still Loses To Villarreal Ending Title Hopes |url=https://www.forbes.com/sites/tomsanderson/2024/01/27/fc-barcelona-mounts-epic-three-goal-eleven-minute-comeback-and-still-loses-to-villarreal-ending-title-hopes/?sh=3b4d93d66941 |access-date=27 January 2024 |website=[[Forbes]] |archive-date=23 January 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250123175935/https://www.forbes.com/sites/tomsanderson/2024/01/27/fc-barcelona-mounts-epic-three-goal-eleven-minute-comeback-and-still-loses-to-villarreal-ending-title-hopes/?sh=3b4d93d66941 |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=27 January 2024 |title=Barcelona vs Villarreal, La Liga: Final Score 3-5, Barça start poorly, complete comeback, collapse again, suffer wild loss at home |url=https://www.barcablaugranes.com/2024/1/27/24051889/barcelona-villarreal-la-liga-final-score-match-report-recap-reactions |access-date=27 January 2024 |website=BarcaBlaugranes.com |archive-date=23 January 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250123182003/https://www.barcablaugranes.com/2024/1/27/24051889/barcelona-villarreal-la-liga-final-score-match-report-recap-reactions |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=27 January 2024 |title=Barcelona concede two goals in extra time in 5-3 loss to Villarreal |url=https://www.givemesport.com/barcelona-concede-two-goals-in-extra-time-in-5-3-loss-to-villarreal/ |access-date=27 January 2024 |website=GiveMeSport.com |archive-date=23 January 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250123173838/https://www.givemesport.com/barcelona-concede-two-goals-in-extra-time-in-5-3-loss-to-villarreal/ |url-status=live}}</ref> In the post-match [[press conference]], Barcelona manager [[Xavi (footballer, born 1980)|Xavi]] announced his decision to step down as the club's head coach at the end of the season, saying: "I took this decision days ago, I already knew it but today was the moment to announce it. I think this decision will help unblocking the team and the mood in here. I think the club needs a change of dynamic and I told the president [[Joan Laporta]]. As a fan, thinking about the club and the players, I think they will be freed up and will be calmer. I have always wanted to be a solution for Barça, as I was two years and three months ago – but thinking with my heart, I think it is best to leave office on 30 June. I thank the president for his trust. We need a change of course for the good of the club and this will de-escalate the situation surrounding Barça. In these four months I will give everything. I'll try to give my all to try and win the league. I think we can have a good season and hopefully the dynamic will change."<ref name="XaviResignation1">{{Cite web |date=27 January 2024 |title=Xavi Hernández announces he is to leave FC Barcelona on 30 June |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3869328/xavi-hernandez-announces-he-is-to-leave-fc-barcelona-on-30-june/featured |access-date=27 January 2024 |website=[[FC Barcelona]] |archive-date=19 January 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250119181450/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3869328/xavi-hernandez-announces-he-is-to-leave-fc-barcelona-on-30-june/featured |url-status=live}}</ref><ref name="XaviResignation2">{{Cite web |date=27 January 2024 |title=Xavi announces he will step down as Barcelona head coach at the end of the season |url=https://theathletic.com/5141893/2024/01/27/xavi-leaves-barcelona-manager/ |access-date=27 January 2024 |website=[[The Athletic]] |archive-date=12 April 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240412173019/https://theathletic.com/5141893/2024/01/27/xavi-leaves-barcelona-manager/ |url-status=live}}</ref><ref name="XaviResignation3">{{Cite web |date=27 January 2024 |title=Barca manager Xavi to leave at the end of the season |url=https://www.reuters.com/sports/soccer/barca-manager-xavi-leave-end-season-2024-01-27/ |access-date=27 January 2024 |website=[[Reuters]]}}</ref><ref name="XaviResignation4">{{Cite web |date=27 January 2024 |title=FC Barcelona Coach Xavi Hernandez Announces Resignation |url=https://www.forbes.com/sites/tomsanderson/2024/01/27/fc-barcelona-coach-xavi-hernandez-announces-resignation/?sh=74a797f24abe |access-date=27 January 2024 |website=[[Forbes]] |archive-date=23 January 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250123182243/https://www.forbes.com/sites/tomsanderson/2024/01/27/fc-barcelona-coach-xavi-hernandez-announces-resignation/?sh=74a797f24abe |url-status=live}}</ref>

Barcelona finished the month with a 1–0 win over [[CA Osasuna|Osasuna]] on 31 January. [[Vitor Roque]] scored his for goal for the club a minute after coming on as a substitute.<ref>{{Cite web |date=31 January 2024 |title=Roque fires Barça to narrow win over Osasuna |url=https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20240131-roque-fires-barca-to-narrow-win-over-osasuna |access-date=31 January 2024 |website=[[France 24]] |archive-date=1 February 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240201173244/https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20240131-roque-fires-barca-to-narrow-win-over-osasuna |url-status=live}}</ref>

=== February ===
On 3 February, Barcelona got a 1–3 away win over [[Deportivo Alavés]] thanks to goals from Lewandowski, Gündoğan and Vitor Roque.<ref>{{Cite web |date=3 February 2024 |title=Vitor Roque scores and is sent off as 10-man Barcelona defeat Alaves to go 3rd in La Liga |url=https://www.football-espana.net/2024/02/03/vitor-roque-scores-and-is-sent-off-as-10-man-barcelona-defeat-alaves-to-go-3rd-in-la-liga |access-date=3 February 2024 |website=Football-Espana.net |archive-date=29 April 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250429203228/https://www.football-espana.net/2024/02/03/vitor-roque-scores-and-is-sent-off-as-10-man-barcelona-defeat-alaves-to-go-3rd-in-la-liga |url-status=live}}</ref>

On 11 February, the team got held to a 3–3 draw against [[Granada CF|Granada]], with Yamal scoring a brace and Lewandowski scoring once.<ref>{{Cite web |date=11 February 2024 |title=Barcelona 3-3 Granada - Lamine Yamal rescues draw for Barca in six-goal thriller in La Liga |url=https://www.eurosport.com/football/la-liga/2023-2024/barcelona-v-granada-la-liga-live_sto10013367/story.shtml |access-date=11 February 2024 |website=[[Eurosport]] |archive-date=28 February 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250228070424/https://www.eurosport.com/football/la-liga/2023-2024/barcelona-v-granada-la-liga-live_sto10013367/story.shtml |url-status=live}}</ref>

On 17 February, Barcelona got a dramatic 1–2 away win against [[RC Celta de Vigo|Celta Vigo]] thanks to a Lewandowski brace, who scored the winning goal in the 97th minute with a penalty kick. With this brace, Lewandowski reached 50 goals with Barcelona, achieving this milestone in 79 matches.<ref>{{Cite web |date=17 February 2024 |title=Barcelona snatch late victory over Celta Vigo courtesy of 97th minute winner |url=https://www.football-espana.net/2024/02/17/barcelona-snatch-late-victory-over-celta-vigo-courtesy-of-97th-minute-winner |access-date=17 February 2024 |website=Football-Espana.net |archive-date=23 March 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250323051602/https://www.football-espana.net/2024/02/17/barcelona-snatch-late-victory-over-celta-vigo-courtesy-of-97th-minute-winner |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=17 February 2024 |title=Celta Vigo 1-2 Barcelona: Robert Lewandowski scores stoppage-time penalty to earn Catalans dramatic victory |url=https://www.eurosport.com/football/la-liga/2023-2024/celta-vigo-v-barcelona-la-liga-live_sto10024516/story.shtml |access-date=17 February 2024 |website=[[Eurosport]] |archive-date=17 February 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240217202257/https://www.eurosport.com/football/la-liga/2023-2024/celta-vigo-v-barcelona-la-liga-live_sto10024516/story.shtml |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=17 February 2024 |title=Lewandowski double snatches tame Barça win at Celta |url=https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20240217-lewandowski-double-snatches-tame-barca-win-at-celta |access-date=17 February 2024 |website=[[France 24]] |archive-date=18 February 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240218123101/https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20240217-lewandowski-double-snatches-tame-barca-win-at-celta |url-status=live}}</ref>

On 21 February, Barcelona drew 1–1 away against [[SSC Napoli|Napoli]] in the first leg of the Champions League Round of 16. Lewandowski scored the team's only goal.<ref>{{Cite news |date=21 February 2024 |title=Lewandowksi and Osimhen trade goals as Barcelona draws 1-1 at Napoli in 1st leg of CL last 16 |url=https://www.washingtonpost.com/sports/soccer/2024/02/21/napoli-barcelona-champions-league/8b041888-d104-11ee-ac8b-765284b5203e_story.html |access-date=21 February 2024 |newspaper=[[The Washington Post]]}}</ref>

Barcelona ended the month with a comfortable 4–0 win against [[Getafe CF|Getafe]] on 24 February, with the goals coming from Raphinha, Félix, De Jong and Fermín.<ref>{{Cite web |date=24 February 2024 |title=🚨 Barcelona go second with smooth Getafe victory |url=https://onefootball.com/en/news/barcelona-go-second-with-smooth-getafe-victory-39101733 |access-date=24 February 2024 |website=OneFootball.com |archive-date=23 January 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250123173616/https://onefootball.com/en/news/barcelona-go-second-with-smooth-getafe-victory-39101733 |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=24 February 2024 |title=Barça festival against Getafe to continue 'dreaming' of LaLiga (4-0) |url=https://www.fcbarcelonanoticias.com/en/laliga/festival-of-the-barca-in-front-of-the-getafe-to-follow-dreaming-with-laliga-4-0_301121_102.html |access-date=24 February 2024 |website=FCBarcelonaNoticias.com |archive-date=17 May 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250517022318/https://www.fcbarcelonanoticias.com/en/laliga/festival-of-the-barca-in-front-of-the-getafe-to-follow-dreaming-with-laliga-4-0_301121_102.html |url-status=live}}</ref> De Jong's goal scored in the 61st minute was Barcelona's [[List of FC Barcelona records and statistics|11,000th goal in the club's history]] in competitive matches.<ref>{{Cite web |date=24 February 2024 |title=Frenkie de Jong scores FC Barcelona's 11,000th goal |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3905165/frenkie-de-jong-scores-fc-barcelonas-11000th-goal |access-date=24 February 2024 |website=FC Barcelona |archive-date=3 January 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250103170047/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3905165/frenkie-de-jong-scores-fc-barcelonas-11000th-goal |url-status=live}}</ref>

=== March ===
On 3 March, Barcelona drew 0–0 against [[Athletic Bilbao]] in a match that saw both Frenkie de Jong and Pedri suffer injuries.<ref>{{Cite web |date=3 March 2024 |title=Pedri and De Jong injured in first half of Barcelona's game at Athletic Bilbao in Spanish league |url=https://apnews.com/article/de-jong-pedri-barcelona-injuries-fc55238cd52cd2de7d3afc9902be25d2 |access-date=3 March 2024 |website=[[Associated Press]] |archive-date=4 March 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240304130754/https://apnews.com/article/de-jong-pedri-barcelona-injuries-fc55238cd52cd2de7d3afc9902be25d2 |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=3 March 2024 |title=Pedri and Frenkie de Jong suffer injury setbacks in Barcelona's clash with Athletic Club |url=https://www.90min.com/posts/pedri-and-frenkie-de-jong-suffer-injury-setbacks-barcelona |access-date=3 March 2024 |website=90min.com |archive-date=10 March 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240310213015/https://www.90min.com/posts/pedri-and-frenkie-de-jong-suffer-injury-setbacks-barcelona |url-status=live}}</ref>

On 8 March, the team got a 1–0 win over [[RCD Mallorca|Mallorca]] thanks to a Yamal goal.<ref>{{Cite web |date=8 March 2024 |title=Barcelona 1-0 Mallorca: Lamine Yamal strike hands Barca narrow win to keep La Liga title hopes alive |url=https://www.eurosport.com/football/la-liga/2023-2024/la-liga-live_sto10048106/story.shtml |access-date=8 March 2024 |website=[[Eurosport]] |archive-date=8 March 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240308224103/https://www.eurosport.com/football/la-liga/2023-2024/la-liga-live_sto10048106/story.shtml |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=8 March 2024 |title=Superb Yamal strike hands Barcelona 1-0 win over Mallorca |url=https://www.reuters.com/sports/soccer/superb-yamal-strike-hands-barcelona-1-0-win-over-mallorca-2024-03-08/ |access-date=8 March 2024 |website=[[Reuters]]}}</ref> [[Marc-André ter Stegen]] made his [[List of FC Barcelona records and statistics|400th appearance]] for the club.<ref name="TerStegen400apps">{{Cite web |date=8 March 2024 |title=Ter Stegen: 400 games for Barça |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3924364/ter-stegen-400-games-for-barca |access-date=8 March 2024 |website=FC Barcelona |archive-date=18 January 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250118213202/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3924364/ter-stegen-400-games-for-barca |url-status=live}}</ref>

On 12 March, Barcelona advanced to the [[2023–24 UEFA Champions League knockout phase|Champions League quarter-finals]] for the first time since the [[2019–20 FC Barcelona season|2019–20 season]] after defeating [[SSC Napoli|Napoli]] 3–1 on the night and 4–2 on aggregate,<ref>{{Cite web |date=12 March 2024 |title=Barça 3-1 Napoli: Into the Champions League quarter-finals! |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3931750/barca-3-1-napoli-into-the-champions-league-quarter-finals |access-date=12 March 2024 |website=FC Barcelona |archive-date=23 January 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250123173800/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3931750/barca-3-1-napoli-into-the-champions-league-quarter-finals |url-status=live}}</ref> with the goals coming from Fermín, Cancelo and Lewandowski.<ref name=":15">{{Cite web |date=12 March 2024 |title=Barcelona into Champions League quarter-finals with 4-2 aggregate win against Napoli |url=https://theathletic.com/5336595/2024/03/12/barcelona-champions-league-napoli/ |access-date=12 March 2024 |website=[[The Athletic]] |archive-date=13 March 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240313093320/https://theathletic.com/5336595/2024/03/12/barcelona-champions-league-napoli/ |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=12 March 2024 |title=Barcelona 3-1 Napoli (4-2 on agg.): Robert Lewandowski among goals as Xavi's side make Champions League quarter-finals |url=https://www.eurosport.com/football/champions-league/2023-2024/fc-barcelona-v-napoli-uefa-champions-league-live_sto10058242/story.shtml |access-date=12 March 2024 |website=[[Eurosport]] |archive-date=13 March 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240313011900/https://www.eurosport.com/football/champions-league/2023-2024/fc-barcelona-v-napoli-uefa-champions-league-live_sto10058242/story.shtml |url-status=live}}</ref> Barcelona became the first team in Champions League history to start two players aged 17 or under in a Champions League knockout match by starting both Yamal and Champions League debutant [[Pau Cubarsí]], the latter of whom became the youngest player to make his debut as a starter in the Champions League knockout stage at 17 years and 50 days and was also named [[Player of the match#Association football|Man of the match]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=12 March 2024 |title=Barcelona 3-1 Napoli (agg: 4-2): Blaugrana overcome brave Napoli display |url=https://www.uefa.com/uefachampionsleague/news/028b-1a650001f519-af3a3cf17e91-1000--report-barca-secure-last-eight-spot/ |access-date=12 March 2024 |website=[[UEFA|UEFA.com]] |archive-date=24 January 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250124074914/https://www.uefa.com/uefachampionsleague/news/028b-1a650001f519-af3a3cf17e91-1000--report-barca-secure-last-eight-spot/ |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=12 March 2024 |title=
Robert Lewandowski provides final touch as Barcelona battle past Napoli |url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/2024/mar/12/barcelona-napoli-champions-league-last-16-second-leg-match-report |access-date=12 March 2024 |website=[[The Guardian]]}}</ref>

On 17 March, Barcelona defeated [[Atlético Madrid]] 0–3 thanks to goals from Félix, Lewandowski and Fermín and climbed to second place in the league standings.<ref>{{Cite web |date=17 March 2024 |title=Atlético Madrid 0-3 FC Barcelona: Sheer brilliance |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3935918/atletico-madrid-0-3-fc-barcelona-sheer-brilliance |access-date=17 March 2024 |website=FC Barcelona |archive-date=14 January 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250114004837/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3935918/atletico-madrid-0-3-fc-barcelona-sheer-brilliance |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=17 March 2024 |title=Atletico Madrid 0-3 Barcelona - Joao Felix scores as Barca end Atleti's 25-match unbeaten home league run |url=https://www.eurosport.com/football/la-liga/2023-2024/atletico-madrid-v-barcelona-la-liga-live_sto10062708/story.shtml |access-date=17 March 2024 |website=[[Eurosport]] |archive-date=17 March 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240317233604/https://www.eurosport.com/football/la-liga/2023-2024/atletico-madrid-v-barcelona-la-liga-live_sto10062708/story.shtml |url-status=live}}</ref>

After the international break, the team got a 1–0 win against [[UD Las Palmas|Las Palmas]] on 30 March, with the goal coming from Raphinha.<ref>{{Cite web |date=30 March 2024 |title=Raphinha breaks the Las Palmas resistance |url=https://www.marca.com/en/football/spanish-football/cronica/2024/03/30/660881bf268e3e09288b4579.html |access-date=30 March 2024 |website=[[Marca (newspaper)|MARCA]] |archive-date=23 January 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250123181206/https://www.marca.com/en/football/spanish-football/cronica/2024/03/30/660881bf268e3e09288b4579.html |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=30 March 2024 |title=Raphinha guides Barca past Las Palmas to pressure leaders Madrid |url=https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20240330-raphinha-guides-barca-past-las-palmas-to-pressure-leaders-madrid |access-date=30 March 2024 |website=[[France 24]] |archive-date=30 March 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240330234055/https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20240330-raphinha-guides-barca-past-las-palmas-to-pressure-leaders-madrid |url-status=live}}</ref>

=== April ===
