On 10 April, Barcelona got a dramatic and hard-fought 2–3 away win against [[Paris Saint-Germain F.C.|Paris Saint-Germain]] in the first leg of the [[2023–24 UEFA Champions League knockout phase#Quarter-finals|Champions League quarter-final]] thanks to a brace from Raphinha, with the winning goal coming from [[Andreas Christensen]] who scored on his 28th birthday.<ref>{{Cite web |date=10 April 2024 |title=Paris Saint Germain 2-3 FC Barcelona: Oh là là!!! |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3961740/paris-saint-germain-2-3-fc-barcelona-oh-la-la |access-date=10 April 2024 |website=FC Barcelona |archive-date=15 May 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250515135348/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3961740/paris-saint-germain-2-3-fc-barcelona-oh-la-la |url-status=live}}</ref><ref name=":16">{{Cite web |date=10 April 2024 |title=Paris Saint-Germain 2-3 FC Barcelona: Andreas Christensen nets winner with first touch in five-goal thriller |url=https://www.eurosport.com/football/champions-league/2023-2024/paris-saint-germain-v-fc-barcelona-uefa-champions-league-live_sto10095668/story.shtml |access-date=10 April 2024 |website=[[Eurosport]] |archive-date=14 April 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240414123641/https://www.eurosport.com/football/champions-league/2023-2024/paris-saint-germain-v-fc-barcelona-uefa-champions-league-live_sto10095668/story.shtml |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=10 April 2024 |title=Paris St-Germain 2-3 Barcelona: Andreas Christensen hits winner in Champions League quarter-final first leg |url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/68773222 |access-date=10 April 2024 |website=[[BBC Sport]] |archive-date=14 August 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250814223253/https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/68773222 |url-status=live}}</ref>

Three days later, the team got a 0–1 away win over [[Cádiz CF|Cádiz]] thanks to a brilliant [[bicycle kick]] goal from Félix and an amazing defensive performance from Ter Stegen.<ref>{{Cite web |date=13 April 2024 |title=Joao Felix's bicycle-kick enough for rotated Barcelona to defeat Cadiz |url=https://www.marca.com/en/football/spanish-football/2024/04/13/661adad346163fa2998b4595.html |access-date=13 April 2024 |website=[[Marca (newspaper)|MARCA]] |archive-date=23 January 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250123174225/https://www.marca.com/en/football/spanish-football/2024/04/13/661adad346163fa2998b4595.html |url-status=live}}</ref>

On 16 April, Barcelona's Champions League journey ended after they suffered a 1–4 defeat in the second leg of the quarter-finals against [[Paris Saint-Germain F.C.|Paris Saint-Germain]] (4–6 on aggregate). Despite Barcelona's promising start thanks to a Raphinha goal, the pivotal moment of Araujo's red card in the 29th minute altered the trajectory of the match and ultimately swung the momentum decisively in PSG's favour.<ref name=":17">{{Cite web |date=16 April 2024 |title=Champions League: Paris Saint-Germain stuns shorthanded Barcelona |url=https://sports.yahoo.com/champions-league-paris-saint-germain-stuns-shorthanded-barcelona-dortmund-rallies-past-madrid-210102297.html |access-date=16 April 2024 |website=[[Yahoo! Sports]]}}</ref>

On 21 April, Barcelona suffered a 3–2 defeat against [[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid]] in a hard-fought match.<ref>{{Cite web |date=21 April 2024 |title=Real Madrid 3 Barcelona 2 – Yamal's 'ghost goal', Bellingham's El Clasico winner – The Briefing |url=https://theathletic.com/5428917/2024/04/21/real-madrid-barcelona-clasico-la-liga-bellingham-yamal/ |access-date=21 April 2024 |website=[[The Athletic]] |archive-date=12 May 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240512191808/https://theathletic.com/5428917/2024/04/21/real-madrid-barcelona-clasico-la-liga-bellingham-yamal/ |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=21 April 2024 |title=Barça loses almost all of its chances in the League in a controversial Clásico against Madrid (3-2) |url=https://www.fcbarcelonanoticias.com/en/laliga/terrible-refereeing-prevents-barca-approaching-madrid-in-clasico-end-up-in-tables-2-2_302830_102.html |access-date=21 April 2024 |website=FCBarcelonaNoticias.com |archive-date=22 May 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250522221529/https://www.fcbarcelonanoticias.com/en/laliga/terrible-refereeing-prevents-barca-approaching-madrid-in-clasico-end-up-in-tables-2-2_302830_102.html |url-status=live}}</ref> It was marked by a controversial ''[[Video assistant referee|VAR]]'' decision when in the 26th minute Yamal guided the ball towards the goal and Real Madrid's goalkeeper Lunin cleared the ball from an inside goal perspective. Four minutes later, after being checked by the ''VAR'', the result was deemed inconclusive because of the lack of the [[goal-line technology]] in La Liga and therefore the goal was not allowed.<ref>{{Cite web |date=21 April 2024 |title=Controversy in El Clasico as VAR denies Barcelona 'goal' when ball looked over |url=https://www.sportbible.com/football/la-liga/fc-barcelona/barcelona-real-madrid-var-la-liga-goalline-technology-945954-20240421 |access-date=21 April 2024 |website=[[SPORTbible]] |archive-date=15 August 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250815123217/https://www.sportbible.com/football/la-liga/fc-barcelona/barcelona-real-madrid-var-la-liga-goalline-technology-945954-20240421 |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=21 April 2024 |title=Why La Liga Doesn't Have Goal-Line Technology |url=https://www.givemesport.com/why-la-liga-doesnt-have-goal-line-technology/ |access-date=21 April 2024 |website=GiveMeSport.com |archive-date=23 January 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250123173957/https://www.givemesport.com/why-la-liga-doesnt-have-goal-line-technology/ |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=21 April 2024 |title=It was a goal, the picture that demonstrates it was a legal goal for Barcelona vs Real Madrid |url=https://www.elfutbolero.us/news/it-was-a-goal-the-picture-that-demonstrates-it-was-a-legal-goal-for-barcelona-vs-real-madrid-20240421-40806.html |access-date=21 April 2024 |website=ElFutbolero.us |archive-date=15 July 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250715110146/https://www.elfutbolero.us/news/it-was-a-goal-the-picture-that-demonstrates-it-was-a-legal-goal-for-barcelona-vs-real-madrid-20240421-40806.html |url-status=live}}</ref>

On 25 April, in a press conference Xavi announced that he had decided to remain Barcelona's head coach and honour his contract that expires in June 2025, reversing his decision to leave the club at the end of this season that he had announced in January, saying that he wanted to "continue with a project that isn't finished and that must be continued... there are several reasons, but the main one was to ensure the stability of the club and to continue building a winning team."<ref>{{Cite web |date=25 April 2024 |title=Xavi: 'The project isn't over, it must continue' |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3982074/xavi-the-project-isnt-over-it-must-continue |access-date=27 April 2024 |website=FC Barcelona |archive-date=8 September 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250908031605/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3982074/xavi-the-project-isnt-over-it-must-continue |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=25 April 2024 |title=Xavi to stay on as Barcelona head coach after talks with Joan Laporta |url=https://theathletic.com/5438264/2024/04/24/xavi-stays-barcelona-manager/ |access-date=27 April 2024 |website=[[The Athletic]] |archive-date=27 April 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240427145216/https://theathletic.com/5438264/2024/04/24/xavi-stays-barcelona-manager/ |url-status=live}}</ref> 

On the same day, the club commemorated the 10th anniversary of the death of Barça's former coach [[Tito Vilanova]] by releasing a 2020 Barça Studios documentary about the coach titled "{{YouTube|id=4XcXMPA064I|''100x100 TITO''}}" on the club's official channel. He is remembered as the only Barcelona coach to reach [[List of FC Barcelona records and statistics#Team records|100 points]] in a league season and his name lives on at the club with the main training pitch named after him at the [[Ciutat Esportiva Joan Gamper]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=25 April 2024 |title=10 years without Tito Vilanova |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3979467/10-years-without-tito-vilanova |access-date=27 April 2024 |website=FC Barcelona |archive-date=13 February 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250213144609/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3979467/10-years-without-tito-vilanova |url-status=live}}</ref>

Barcelona ended the month with a 4–2 comeback victory against [[Valencia CF|Valencia]] on 29 April, with Fermín scoring a goal and Lewandowski scoring a second half [[hat-trick]] which included a free kick goal in the last minute of the match.<ref>{{Cite web |date=29 April 2024 |title=Barcelona 4-2 Valencia: Robert Lewandowski treble guides Xavi's side past 10-man visitors in La Liga |url=https://www.eurosport.com/football/la-liga/2023-2024/barcelona-v-valencia-la-liga-live_sto10121859/story.shtml |access-date=29 April 2024 |website=[[Eurosport]] |archive-date=28 February 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250228073134/https://www.eurosport.com/football/la-liga/2023-2024/barcelona-v-valencia-la-liga-live_sto10121859/story.shtml |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=29 April 2024 |title=FC Barcelona 4-2 Valencia: Hat-trick seals comeback win |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3989516/fc-barcelona-4-2-valencia-hat-trick-seals-comeback-win |access-date=29 April 2024 |website=FC Barcelona |archive-date=21 June 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250621180357/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3989516/fc-barcelona-4-2-valencia-hat-trick-seals-comeback-win |url-status=live}}</ref>

=== May ===
On 4 May, Barcelona suffered a 4–2 defeat against [[Girona FC|Girona]], with Christensen and Lewandowski scoring the only goals for the team.<ref>{{Cite web |date=4 May 2024 |title=Girona 4-2 FC Barcelona: Defeat at Montilivi |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3995400/girona-4-2-fc-barcelona-defeat-at-montilivi |access-date=4 May 2024 |website=FC Barcelona |archive-date=15 May 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250515135348/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3995400/girona-4-2-fc-barcelona-defeat-at-montilivi |url-status=live}}</ref> On 13 May, the team got a 2–0 win against [[Real Sociedad]] thanks to goals from Yamal and Raphinha, which took the team back to second place in the league table.<ref>{{Cite web |date=13 May 2024 |title=Barcelona 2-0 Real Sociedad - Lamine Yamal and Raphinha goals lift Barca into second in La Liga table |url=https://www.eurosport.com/football/la-liga/2023-2024/barcelona-v-real-sociedad-la-liga-live_sto10143666/story.shtml |access-date=13 May 2024 |website=[[Eurosport]] |archive-date=28 February 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250228071527/https://www.eurosport.com/football/la-liga/2023-2024/barcelona-v-real-sociedad-la-liga-live_sto10143666/story.shtml |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |date=13 May 2024 |title=Barcelona beat Real Sociedad to move second |url=https://sportsbrief.com/football/64958-barcelona-beat-real-sociedad-move-second/ |access-date=13 May 2024 |publisher=Sports Brief |archive-date=13 May 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240513215602/https://sportsbrief.com/football/64958-barcelona-beat-real-sociedad-move-second/ |url-status=live}}</ref> Three days later, Barcelona got a 0–2 away win against [[UD Almería|Almería]] thanks to a brace from Fermín López who reached ten goals with the club.<ref>{{Cite web |date=16 May 2024 |title=Barcelona brush aside lowly Almeria thanks to Fermin Lopez brace |url=https://www.marca.com/en/football/spanish-football/2024/05/16/6646592122601db3238b4582.html |access-date=16 May 2024 |website=[[Marca (newspaper)|MARCA]] |archive-date=23 January 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250123174705/https://www.marca.com/en/football/spanish-football/2024/05/16/6646592122601db3238b4582.html |url-status=live}}</ref>

On 19 May, Barcelona defeated [[Rayo Vallecano]] 3–0 in their last home match of the season thanks to a brace from Pedri and a goal from Lewandowski.<ref>{{Cite web |date=19 May 2024 |title=FC Barcelona 3-0 Rayo Vallecano: Lewy and Pedri get it done |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/4022335/fc-barcelona-3-0-rayo-vallecano-lewy-and-pedri-get-it-done |access-date=19 May 2024 |website=FC Barcelona |archive-date=15 May 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250515135348/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/4022335/fc-barcelona-3-0-rayo-vallecano-lewy-and-pedri-get-it-done |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=19 May 2024 |title=Pedri runs rings around Rayo Vallecano as Barcelona secure second spot in La Liga |url=https://www.goal.com/en/lists/pedri-runs-rings-around-rayo-vallecano-barcelona-secure-second-spot-la-liga/bltd4e0ccfb5391710d#csc15407c54542c461 |access-date=19 May 2024 |website=[[Goal (website)|Goal.com]] |archive-date=23 January 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250123175308/https://www.goal.com/en/lists/pedri-runs-rings-around-rayo-vallecano-barcelona-secure-second-spot-la-liga/bltd4e0ccfb5391710d#csc15407c54542c461 |url-status=live}}</ref> With this win, the team secured second place in the league and qualified for the next season's [[Supercopa de España]].<ref name=":20">{{Cite web |date=19 May 2024 |title=FC Barcelona secure second place |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/4020597/fc-barcelona-secure-second-place |access-date=19 May 2024 |website=FC Barcelona |archive-date=17 November 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251117103138/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/4020597/fc-barcelona-secure-second-place |url-status=live}}</ref> It was a match of milestones as Araújo made his 150th appearance for the club, with both Gündoğan and Yamal playing their 50th match for the club, making Yamal the youngest player in the club's history to reach 50 appearances at the age of 16 years, 10 months and six days, beating the previous record held by [[Bojan Krkić]] who made his 50th appearance at the age of 18 years and three days in August 2008.<ref>{{Cite web |date=19 May 2024 |title=Lamine Yamal, the youngest FC Barcelona to reach 50 appearances |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/4018431/lamine-yamal-the-youngest-fc-barcelona-to-reach-50-appearances |access-date=19 May 2024 |website=FC Barcelona |archive-date=27 April 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250427024154/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/4018431/lamine-yamal-the-youngest-fc-barcelona-to-reach-50-appearances |url-status=live}}</ref>

On 26 May, Barcelona defeated [[Sevilla FC|Sevilla]] 1–2 in their last match of the season thanks to goals from Robert Lewandowski and Fermín López.<ref>{{Cite web |date=26 May 2024 |title=Xavi leaves Barcelona on a high with narrow victory over Sevilla |url=https://www.marca.com/en/football/spanish-football/2024/05/26/6653920ee2704e097c8b45b4.html |access-date=26 May 2024 |website=[[Marca (newspaper)|MARCA]] |archive-date=23 January 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250123175335/https://www.marca.com/en/football/spanish-football/2024/05/26/6653920ee2704e097c8b45b4.html |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=26 May 2024 |title=Sevilla 1-2 Barcelona: Robert Lewandowski and Fermin Lopez on target in La Liga as Xavi signs off from Blaugrana |url=https://www.eurosport.com/football/la-liga/2023-2024/sevilla-fc-v-fc-barcelona-la-liga-live_sto10160659/story.shtml |access-date=26 May 2024 |website=[[Eurosport]] |archive-date=28 February 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250228065230/https://www.eurosport.com/football/la-liga/2023-2024/sevilla-fc-v-fc-barcelona-la-liga-live_sto10160659/story.shtml |url-status=live}}</ref> It was [[Xavi (footballer, born 1980)|Xavi]]'s last match as the head coach of the club after it was announced two days earlier that he would not continue as the manager next season, reversing the club's last month decision to continue with Xavi as the head coach.<ref name=":21">{{Cite web |date=24 May 2024 |title=Xavi not to continue as FC Barcelona first team coach |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/4027349/xavi-not-to-continue-as-fc-barcelona-first-team-coach |access-date=26 May 2024 |website=FC Barcelona |archive-date=19 April 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250419073307/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/4027349/xavi-not-to-continue-as-fc-barcelona-first-team-coach |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |date=26 May 2024 |title=Barça says goodbye to LaLiga and Xavi with a great victory against Sevilla (1-2) |url=https://www.fcbarcelonanoticias.com/en/laliga/the-barca-sacks-laliga-and-to-xavi-with-big-victory-in-front-of-the-seville-1-2_303878_102.html |access-date=26 May 2024 |publisher=FC Barcelona Noticias |archive-date=8 August 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240808133726/https://www.fcbarcelonanoticias.com/en/laliga/the-barca-sacks-laliga-and-to-xavi-with-big-victory-in-front-of-the-seville-1-2_303878_102.html |url-status=live}}</ref>

On 29 May, Barcelona announced that the German manager [[Hansi Flick]] would become the team's head coach starting next season with a contract until 30 June 2026.<ref name=":22">{{Cite web |date=29 May 2024 |title=Hansi Flick is the new FC Barcelona coach |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/4029878/hansi-flick-is-the-new-fc-barcelona-coach |access-date=29 May 2024 |website=FC Barcelona |archive-date=29 May 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240529114441/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/4029878/hansi-flick-is-the-new-fc-barcelona-coach |url-status=live}}</ref>

=== Copa del Rey ===
{{Main|2023–24 Copa del Rey}}
Barcelona entered the tournament in the round of 32, where they defeated [[UD Barbastro|Barbastro]] 3–2 and advanced to the [[2023–24 Copa del Rey#Round of 16|round of 16]]. In the round of 16, Barcelona defeated [[Unionistas de Salamanca CF|Unionistas]] 3–1 and advanced to the [[2023–24 Copa del Rey#Quarter-finals|quarter-finals]]. Barcelona were eliminated from the tournament after they suffered a 4–2 away defeat against [[Athletic Bilbao]] in the quarter-finals.<ref name=":19">{{cite web|url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/futbol/primer-equip/noticies/3866820/athletic-club--barca-adeu-cruel-a-la-copa-4-2|title=Athletic Club 4-2 FC Barcelona: Knocked out in extra time|publisher=FC Barcelona|date=25 January 2024|access-date=10 February 2024|archive-date=23 January 2025|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250123175530/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/futbol/primer-equip/noticies/3866820/athletic-club--barca-adeu-cruel-a-la-copa-4-2|url-status=live}}</ref>

=== Supercopa de España ===
{{Main|2023–24 Supercopa de España}}
Barcelona qualified for the tournament by winning the [[2022–23 La Liga#League table|2022–23 La Liga]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Supercopa de España 2024: equipos, formato, fechas y calendario|trans-title=2024 Supercopa de España: teams, format, dates, and schedule|url=https://www.marca.com/futbol/supercopa-espana/2023/05/14/646134f3268e3e51098b4581.html|publisher=MARCA|language=Spanish|date=14 May 2023|access-date=18 May 2023|archive-date=18 May 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230518094656/https://www.marca.com/futbol/supercopa-espana/2023/05/14/646134f3268e3e51098b4581.html|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=FC Barcelona, Liga champions 2022/23!|url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/football/first-team/news/3344756/fc-barcelona-liga-champions-202223|publisher=FC Barcelona|date=14 May 2023|access-date=18 May 2023|archive-date=2 December 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181202111602/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/|url-status=live}}</ref> 

On 11 January, they beat [[CA Osasuna|Osasuna]] 2–0 in the semi-final and advanced to the [[2024 Supercopa de España final]]. In the final, Barcelona suffered a 4–1 defeat against [[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid]].<ref name=":18">{{cite web|url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/futbol/primer-equip/noticies/3857625/reial-madrid--fc-barcelona-sescapa-la-supercopa-4-1|title=Real Madrid 4-1 FC Barcelona: Super Cup defeat|publisher=FC Barcelona|date=14 January 2024|access-date=10 February 2024|archive-date=27 February 2024|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240227095630/https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/futbol/primer-equip/noticies/3857625/reial-madrid--fc-barcelona-sescapa-la-supercopa-4-1|url-status=live}}</ref>

===UEFA Champions League===
{{Main|2023–24 UEFA Champions League}}

==== Group stage ====
{{Main|2023–24 UEFA Champions League group stage#Group H}}
Barcelona, as a [[2022–23 La Liga#League table|last season]]'s winner of one of the highest ranked leagues in Europe, entered in Pot 1 for the group stage draw, which was held on 31 August 2023.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.uefa.com/uefachampionsleague/news/0284-18dd7960fa09-4e1923dabdbf-1000--group-stage-draw-pots-confirmed/|title=Champions League group stage draw pots confirmed|date=31 August 2023|publisher=UEFA|access-date=8 February 2024|archive-date=3 November 2025|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251103103623/https://www.uefa.com/uefachampionsleague/news/0284-18dd7960fa09-4e1923dabdbf-1000--group-stage-draw-pots-confirmed/|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.90min.com/es/posts/como-funciona-la-clasificacion-para-la-champions-los-equipos-que-estan-clasificados-para-la-edicion-2023-24|title=¿Cómo funciona la clasificación para la Champions? Los equipos que están clasificados para la edición 2023/24|trans-title=How does Champions League qualification work? The teams qualified for the 2023/24 edition|publisher=90 MIN|date=26 April 2023|language=es|access-date=10 June 2023|archive-date=10 June 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230610043034/https://www.90min.com/es/posts/como-funciona-la-clasificacion-para-la-champions-los-equipos-que-estan-clasificados-para-la-edicion-2023-24|url-status=live}}</ref> Barcelona were drawn into Group H alongside last season's [[2022–23 Primeira Liga|Primeira Liga]] runners-up [[FC Porto|Porto]], [[2022–23 Ukrainian Premier League|Ukrainian Premier League]] champions [[FC Shakhtar Donetsk|Shakhtar Donetsk]] and [[2022–23 Belgian Pro League|Belgian Pro League]] champions [[Royal Antwerp F.C.|Antwerp]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.uefa.com/uefachampionsleague/news/027a-1641dbcb4419-56bd0f3d6fd8-1000--2023-24-uefa-champions-league-matches-final-key-dates/|title=2023/24 UEFA Champions League: Matches, final, key dates|publisher=[[UEFA]]|date=8 June 2023|access-date=10 June 2023|archive-date=11 November 2025|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251111022919/https://www.uefa.com/uefachampionsleague/news/027a-1641dbcb4419-56bd0f3d6fd8-1000--2023-24-uefa-champions-league-matches-final-key-dates/|url-status=live}}</ref>

====Knockout phase====
{{Main|2023–24 UEFA Champions League knockout phase}}

===== Round of 16 =====
As a result of finishing top of the group, Barcelona were seeded for the round of 16 draw which took place on 18 December 2023, and would play the second leg at home. They were drawn against [[Serie A|Italian]] side [[SSC Napoli|Napoli]], who finished second in [[2023–24 UEFA Champions League group stage#Group C|Group C]].<ref>{{cite news|title=UEFA Champions League round of 16 draw|publisher=UEFA|url=https://www.uefa.com/uefachampionsleague/draws/2024/2001776/|date=18 December 2023|access-date=1 February 2024|archive-date=19 December 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231219140200/https://www.uefa.com/uefachampionsleague/draws/2024/2001776/|url-status=live}}</ref>

===== Quarter-finals =====
The draw for the remaining knockout rounds of the competition was held on 15 March 2024 in [[Nyon]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.uefa.com/uefachampionsleague/news/027a-1641dbcb4419-56bd0f3d6fd8-1000/|title=2023/24 UEFA Champions League: Matches, final, key dates|publisher=[[UEFA]]|date=1 November 2022|access-date=13 March 2024|archive-date=25 January 2025|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250125201508/https://www.uefa.com/uefachampionsleague/news/027a-1641dbcb4419-56bd0f3d6fd8-1000/|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.uefa.com/uefachampionsleague/news/0286-194ebf918fa5-fdad65c9e4af-1000--uefa-champions-league-quarter-final-semi-final-and-final-/|title=UEFA Champions League quarter-final, semi-final and final draws: Where are they, when are they, who is involved?|publisher=[[UEFA]]|date=13 March 2024|access-date=13 March 2024|archive-date=29 April 2025|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250429020349/https://www.uefa.com/uefachampionsleague/news/0286-194ebf918fa5-fdad65c9e4af-1000--uefa-champions-league-quarter-final-semi-final-and-final-/|url-status=live}}</ref> Barcelona were drawn to face [[Ligue 1]] [[2022–23 Ligue 1#League table|champions]] [[Paris Saint-Germain F.C.|Paris Saint-Germain]] in the quarter-finals, with the second leg being played at home. Paris Saint-Germain finished second in [[2023–24 UEFA Champions League group stage#Group F|Group F]] and progressed past [[Real Sociedad]] 4–1 on aggregate in the [[2023–24 UEFA Champions League knockout phase#Real Sociedad v Paris Saint-Germain|round of 16]].<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.uefa.com/uefachampionsleague/news/028b-1a6a23265d8b-103c8d8e89c6-1000--champions-league-quarter-final-draw/|title=Champions League quarter-final draw: Real Madrid vs Man City, Paris vs Barcelona|publisher=[[UEFA]]|date=15 March 2024|access-date=15 March 2024|archive-date=11 August 2025|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250811113518/https://www.uefa.com/uefachampionsleague/news/028b-1a6a23265d8b-103c8d8e89c6-1000--champions-league-quarter-final-draw/|url-status=live}}</ref>
